name: Pink Passion - Flower - Sativa
description:
Apples and Bananas x Grape Gas | Sativa | Fruity
Terpenes: Myrcene, Pinene, Ocimene

Pink Passion blends tangy passion fruit flavors with sweet citrus and floral notes, underpinned by lemony freshness and a hint of earthy kush. Its aroma is a captivating mix of sweet citrus and sour earth, creating a rich sensory experience. This hybrid strain offers a balanced, creative, and joyful high.
